question.text: Which of the following is nucleophilic addition reaction?

options.text: Hydrolysis of ethyl chloride by NaOH

solution.text: Sodium hydrogen sulphite adds to aldehydes and ketones to form crystalline bisulphite addition products. The product is water soluble and can be converted back to the original carbonyl compound by treating it with dilute mineral acid or alkali. Therefore, these are useful for separation and purification of aldehydes like acetaldehydes.
